race.comment: WESTERN LADY (2) has been sound without setting the world alight over shorter trips recently, but the step out in distance now and booking of Pike suggests she's ready to fire third-up. Has won on the quick turnaround previously, so that's no issue and she looks poised to strike now. ADMIRE ASTRA (4) has had plenty of market support this time in work after some strong performances in Stakes grade last campaign. Now out to a more suitable trip with a strong fitness base, she makes plenty of appeal, particularly with John Allen booked for the ride. TAHNI TALK (1) draws the inside now with Damian Lane booked as he steps out to this trip third-up. He improved quickly under a similar scenario last campaign and the inside draw should see him get every chance. ROMMEO (3) is racing well of late and can't be discounted with no weight on his back. ALASKAN (5) bolted in two back but was just fair here last week. The rise in trip can see him bounce back to his best.
